Developer Tools

Developer Tools apps for Omarchy

13 packages from the official Omarchy repository.

Reviewed 2026-10-21 · independent editorial guide

Short answer

Install any of these with omarchy pkg add <name>. The list below has all 13 developer tools packages in the official repo as of 2026-10-21.

Every developer tools package

Listed alphabetically. Categories are this site's own grouping; the packages and versions come from pkgs.omarchy.org.

  • bun-bin omarchy pkg add bun-bin
    One fast binary that replaces Node.js, npm, webpack, and your test runner.
  • cursor-bin omarchy pkg add cursor-bin
    An AI-first code editor built to build ambitious software.
  • mise-bin omarchy pkg add mise-bin
    One CLI to install your dev tools, load your env vars, and run your project tasks.
  • omarchy-emacs omarchy pkg add omarchy-emacs
    Keeps Emacs looking and feeling like the rest of your Omarchy desktop, automatically.
  • omarchy-nvim omarchy pkg add omarchy-nvim
    A ready-to-go LazyVim setup for Neovim, plugins pre-cached so it starts fast on first launch.
  • omazed omarchy pkg add omazed
    Keeps your Zed editor theme in lockstep with whatever Omarchy color scheme you're running.
  • once-bin omarchy pkg add once-bin
    Turns any Linux or Mac machine into a self-hosted server for Docker web apps, with one install command.
  • python-mediapipe omarchy pkg add python-mediapipe
    Google's toolkit for running ready-made ML models for vision, audio and text right on-device.
  • python-sounddevice omarchy pkg add python-sounddevice
    Python bindings for PortAudio to record and play back sound as NumPy arrays.
  • sublime-text-4 omarchy pkg add sublime-text-4
    The fast, endlessly customizable text editor that trusts you to pay for it.
  • symfony-cli omarchy pkg add symfony-cli
    The official command-line companion for building and running Symfony PHP applications.
  • tobi-try omarchy pkg add tobi-try
    Type a word, land in a fresh, dated folder for whatever idea you're chasing right now.
  • visual-studio-code-bin omarchy pkg add visual-studio-code-bin
    The code editor most developers open first.
